def transform(grid):
    """Extend each diagonal color run toward the lower edge; if blocked, reverse."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = grid[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value != background}

    for color in colors:
        points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                  if grid[r][c] == color]
        extended = False
        for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(points):
            for r2, c2 in points[i + 1:]:
                if abs(r2 - r1) != 1 or abs(c2 - c1) != 1:
                    continue
                # Orient pair from top to bottom and extend its diagonal ray
                # downward. If the next cell is blocked/outside, try backward.
                if r1 < r2:
                    top, bottom = (r1, c1), (r2, c2)
                else:
                    top, bottom = (r2, c2), (r1, c1)
                dr = 1
                dc = bottom[1] - top[1]

                r, c = bottom[0] + dr, bottom[1] + dc
                if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == background:
                    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == background:
                        out[r][c] = color
                        r += dr
                        c += dc
                else:
                    r, c = top[0] - dr, top[1] - dc
                    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == background:
                        out[r][c] = color
                        r -= dr
                        c -= dc
                extended = True
                break
            if extended:
                break
    return out
